title: Structured logger
description: Framework-neutral TypeScript JSON-lines logger with levels, child bindings, deterministic key-based redaction, bounded cycle-safe serialization, error cause chains, an injectable sink and clock, and x-request-id correlation for Fetch Request objects.

notes: Requires a TypeScript build; no runtime packages. Uses TextEncoder, console, and (for withRequest) the standard Request, Headers, and crypto.randomUUID.
Tested on Node.js 22 in this repository. Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers expose the same standard APIs but were not executed here.
The default sink writes to console.log/console.error; log shipping, files, and retention belong to the hosting platform or an injected sink.

configuration: createLogger({ level, sink, base, redact, includeStack, clock, maxDepth, maxStringLength, maxArrayLength, maxKeys, maxCauseDepth, maxLineBytes }); every option has a safe default.
Pass the level from application configuration (for example an env-config field); the module does not read environment variables.
Add application-specific sensitive field names through redact; they extend the default list.
withRequest(logger, request, { header, trustIncoming, generate }) returns a child logger and requestId; set the same ID on the response.
limitations: Redaction matches whole key names after normalization (case, -, _, ., spaces); it does not scan values or message text, so secrets inside msg or under unlisted keys are logged.
Writes synchronously to the sink with no buffering, batching, sampling, async transport, or delivery guarantee; sink exceptions are swallowed.
Records over maxLineBytes are replaced by a truncation notice rather than split.
No OpenTelemetry trace context, W3C traceparent parsing, or pretty-printing is included.
Error stacks are omitted unless includeStack is true; stack text can still reveal file paths when enabled.
decisions: one JSON line per call: time, level, msg, then fields
redacts whole keys (password, token, cookie...); values and msg are not scanned
incoming request ID reused only if it matches [A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}, else a new one
options: level (default info); includeStack (false); redact: extra keys; maxLineBytes (16,384, then truncated)
